items.summary: Handoff: retain the current private launch gate and reject any rights-dependent public launch or monetization change. Woot API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights remain unproven; 0 of 4 legal launch tasks are closed. Continue the consolidated evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix only.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive safeguards. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream rights are unproven; security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown, with banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy artifacts provide partial evidence only; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: upstream API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence. Smallest next actions are: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, incident, and data-request procedures.

Compliance, data quality, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Analytics is broadly available but has permission/error and freshness limitations; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only, with $4.92 aggregate commission not site-attributable. Do not treat failed telemetry as zero or claim ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only; create no new production, tracking, monetization, or go-live work.
